name: 长照寺
status: draft; not implemented; positions to be fixed after the first whitebox
units: metres; +x east; +z south; north is -z; y up; origin at the centre of the temple gate (山门)
yaw_convention: degrees clockwise from north (-z); east = 90, south = 180, west = 270
height_note: ground_m is the local floor elevation relative to the gate (design proposal, not survey); eye_m is above the local ground. SRTM cannot resolve the hall floor or the altar.
season_time: late autumn, 16:00–17:30, low WSW sun (Z01 interior side daylight); winter snow as a variant

cameras.name: 前院
cameras.purpose: the first courtyard inside the gate; the axis, the bell/drum towers, the hall's deep eaves, the stupa tip
cameras.notes: Stand just inside the gate; fov 60 to hold the two towers at the edges and the hall at the centre. The gate is behind the camera.

cameras.name: 门口适应区
cameras.purpose: the threshold of the Great Buddha Hall; the door frame, the brick carvings, the dark interior, the first partial view of the Buddha
must_show: 门两侧砖雕（祇园演法/西方圣境）
佛的侧身一小块（不是全长）
cameras.notes: The exposure should adapt over 2–3 s; the player sees the flank, not the head or feet. The door is 3.6 m wide by design.

cameras.name: 巨像近侧
cameras.purpose: beside the head/hand; the ear, the hand, the folds, the ten disciples; the scale of the body
cameras.notes: The west-door side light rakes the face and hand; the face is lit by bounce, not direct sun. The ear is about 4 m (published claim; do not put the number in UI).

cameras.name: 侧向观察
cameras.purpose: the south aisle at the feet, looking north along the 34.5 m body; the full length, the head far, the eighteen arhats
cameras.notes: This is the 'full length' shot: only at one end does 34.5 m read. The camera stands in the south aisle; the body recedes from right-near (feet) to centre-far (head).

cameras.name: 经卷展柜
cameras.purpose: inside the Sutra Library; the cabinets, the display cases, the gold sutra, the Northern Canon, the labels
cameras.notes: Low illuminance, 3,000 K, no UV; the gold is dark, not bright. The player stands 1.5 m from the case.

cameras.name: 院外远景
cameras.purpose: from the plaza, looking back at the gate, the roofs, the 33.37 m stupa, and the low city
must_show: 山门、钟鼓楼、大佛殿深檐
cameras.notes: The afternoon sun is behind the camera; the gate/roofs are lit, the stupa is a warm silhouette. The stupa must clear the roofs.

scale_arc.amount: the hall is a dark mass; the Buddha is not visible

scale_arc.sees: door frame and a sliver of the flank

scale_arc.amount: close; the body is larger than the doorway
whole; head and feet in frame
the canon is larger than a life
the temple is small in the city; the Buddha is huge inside

to_verify_after_whitebox: every camera stands on walkable ground
cam02 shows only a partial Buddha, not the full length
cam04 keeps both head and feet in frame; the aisle is at least 2.5 m
cam05 labels are readable at 1.62 m; the gold is not blown
cam06 keeps the stupa above the roofs; the city is low-rise
the west-door light reaches the Buddha's flank at 16:00–17:30
the hall's interior is readable in shadow, not crushed
